admin.agent.skill_hint: Copy this prompt to your agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw…), then send it the key you issued under Agents. The agent saves each project's URL and key in a private local credentials file (readable only by you), never in a repository. For several projects, copy the prompt from this page on each site. Note: the key stays in the chat history — revoke it under Agents if it leaks or is no longer needed.
admin.agent.skill_prompt:
Please add "{app}" ({url}) as a project you can manage, under the project name "{name}".

1. If you don't have the site-admin skill yet, download these two files into a site-admin folder in your skills directory (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/site-admin/). If it's already installed, skip this step and don't overwrite it: the client can read every project's key, so update it only when I explicitly ask, from a site I trust.
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=SKILL.md → site-admin/SKILL.md
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=admin-client.mjs → site-admin/scripts/admin-client.mjs
2. I'll send you this project's admin key (starts with sa_admin_) next. Save it via stdin — never as a command argument — and never repeat it afterwards:
   printf '%s' '<key>' | node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs add {name} {url}
3. Run node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs --project {name} list and tell me which operations you can call.
4. From then on, follow SKILL.md strictly for the admin tasks I give you; when managing several projects, name the project with --project on every call.
admin.agent.full_docs: Full reference (idempotency, audit, local stdio MCP bridge, CLI agent/key management): docs/admin-agent.md in the repository.
admin.agent.never_warning: A non-expiring key works until you revoke it. Give the agent minimal roles, and revoke the key as soon as it's no longer needed or may have leaked.
admin.agent.created_warning: Copy this key now — it won't be shown again. Store it in the agent's secret store, never in the repository.
admin.agent.revoke_warning: Revoke this key? Agents using it lose access immediately. This can't be undone.
admin.agent.accounts_hint: Each agent is an API-type user: its permissions are the RBAC roles you assign, and it signs in only with its admin API keys. Agents aren't counted as users.
admin.agent.agent_form_hint: Pick the roles this agent acts with. You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
admin.agent.no_agents: No agents yet. Create one, assign roles, then issue a key.
admin.agent.keys_hint: Admin API keys (sa_admin_…) for this agent. Only a hash is stored; a key is shown once. They never work on the product API.
admin.agent.delete_warning: The agent account, its role assignments and all its keys are removed. Agents using them lose access immediately. Its execution history is kept.

landing.faq.title: About your southparkmaker character
landing.faq.description: Answers about customizing, downloading, saving, and getting help with your cartoon avatar.
landing.faq.stack.question: How do I create my own character?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Open the character builder, choose a preset, and customize the available hair, clothing, expression, and background options. The preview updates as you make changes.
landing.faq.payment.question: How does AI generation use credits?
landing.faq.payment.answer: AI generation requires a signed-in account and uses credits when enabled. The generator shows the cost for your selected resolution before you submit. Use the manual builder to customize a character and export a PNG or SVG.
landing.faq.database.question: Where are my saved characters stored?
landing.faq.database.answer: Manual designs saved on this device stay in the current browser. They do not automatically sync to other devices. Download a PNG or SVG to keep a separate copy.
landing.faq.customize.question: How can I get help?
landing.faq.customize.answer: Email support@southparkmaker.com for help with character creation, downloads, your account, or payments. You can also submit a support ticket when signed in.
landing.faq.license.question: Is southparkmaker an official South Park tool?
landing.faq.license.answer: southparkmaker is an independent creative tool inspired by the paper-cut cartoon aesthetic. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by South Park or its rights holders. Use only photos and other materials you have permission to use.

admin.operations.cohort_hint: Cohort: first visit in the selected period, followed through to now. One browser ID per visitor; linked users count only in their earliest browser cohort. Steps count distinct cohort members, not impressions; plan selection is optional. AI users have created a task. Source, country, entry page and build never change on return visits. Staff, service accounts and test browsers are excluded. Top 100 groups shown.
admin.operations.daily_hint: Calendar days in UTC+08:00. Sign-ups are counted by registration date; payers and orders by payment date. Today is partial.
admin.operations.method_source: Adapted from the supplied Gefei operations notes: keep data in your database, compare matching hours, investigate the funnel and record each experiment. Case-study claims and screenshots are reference material, not this site’s results.
admin.operations.method_metrics: Revenue is grouped by the actual payment currency, in its correct minor units. It includes renewals in the daily totals and subtracts recorded refunds from the original paid orders; refunds therefore revise the original payment day. Cohort revenue excludes renewals. Completed tasks determine AI success rate; pending tasks are shown separately. A dash means no observations or no denominator.
admin.operations.method_experiments: The journal stores observations, hypotheses, changes, build versions and reviews. Sample targets are plans, not measured traffic. It does not allocate A/B traffic or estimate a winning probability. Define the product variants, exposure event and attribution window before enabling a live experiment.
admin.operations.method_tracking: Visitor collection starts after this feature is installed, honors cookie consent, Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control, and ignores known bots and private pages. Local development usually has no country header. Open a fresh test browser with ?ops_test=1 on its first visit to exclude that browser. Build IDs come from Git at build time; deployments may override VITE_BUILD_ID. Anonymous traffic is browser-based and cannot identify the same person across devices.
admin.operations.experiments_hint: Record the data, hypothesis and change before experimenting; save the evidence and outcome afterward. This journal does not change live traffic or pricing.
admin.operations.no_experiments_hint: Which step loses the most users? Record a specific observation, a testable hypothesis and the change you plan to make.
admin.operations.result_hint: Actual samples, revenue, dates and decision
admin.operations.review_hint: Insufficient evidence is a valid outcome. Record it explicitly; a completed review cannot be overwritten.

maker.how.description_1: Open the studio and select a preset close to your idea. Hair and outfit colors can be changed later. For an imagined scene, switch to the AI generator and describe your character.

maker.faq.title: South Park character maker FAQs.
maker.faq.description: Straightforward answers about making, saving, and using your character.
maker.faq.question_1: What is a South Park character maker?
maker.faq.answer_1: southparkmaker is an online interactive tool for creating personalized cartoon characters inspired by the South Park paper-cut aesthetic. Customize your hairstyle, skin tone, outfit, expression, and background in the manual editor, or try optional AI generation when available.
maker.faq.question_2: Do I need an account to create a character?
maker.faq.answer_2: The manual builder works in your browser without an account. Customize your character and download a PNG or SVG. AI generation requires a signed-in account and uses credits when enabled.
maker.faq.question_3: How does the photo-to-character option work?
maker.faq.answer_3: Choose From a photo in the AI studio, sign in, and upload one PNG, JPEG, or WebP image up to 3 MB. Add optional details, review the credit cost, and generate. Your photo guides the hairstyle, outfit, and overall look; results can vary.
maker.faq.question_4: Can I download a transparent character image?
maker.faq.answer_4: Yes. Open Scene in the builder and select Transparent before exporting. Your PNG or SVG will have no background. This is useful for placing the avatar into another design without a square scene around it. Keep a downloaded copy of your finished version.
maker.faq.question_5: Are my saved characters available on other devices?
maker.faq.answer_5: The builder saves editable designs in this browser on this device. They do not automatically appear on another phone, computer, or browser. Clearing browser storage can remove those saves. Download your image to keep a separate copy you can move wherever you need it.
maker.faq.question_6: Is this the official South Park avatar creator?
maker.faq.answer_6: southparkmaker is an independent creative tool inspired by the paper-cut cartoon aesthetic. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by South Park or its rights holders. Create original characters and use only photos, likenesses, or other materials you have permission to use.

maker.seo.title: A little more character in every detail.
maker.seo.intro: Create an original avatar with the South Park paper-cut look: round heads, flat shapes, and expressive faces. Choose recognizable details to suggest a personality. No drawing experience is needed.
maker.seo.detail_body_1: Try short hair, curls, long hair, a bob, or spikes, then add a beanie or cap. For a cartoon version of yourself, start with your most recognizable feature. For an invented character, let the silhouette suggest a personality.
maker.seo.detail_title_2: Use color to connect the look
maker.seo.detail_body_2: Choose an outfit color first, then coordinate the hair and accessories. Compare a bright jacket against snow with a softer outfit in the park. The live preview helps you judge the whole palette.
maker.seo.detail_title_3: Let the expression tell the story
maker.seo.detail_body_3: A happy, calm, surprised, or grumpy face changes the character's personality. Try glasses or freckles for extra detail, and check that the face remains clear at avatar size.
maker.seo.detail_body_4: Choose snowy mountains, a park, or plain paper to support the character. Use a transparent background when placing the avatar into another design. You can change the scene before exporting another version.
maker.use.title: Your avatar, outside the studio.
maker.use.description: Choose a destination for your avatar, then match its expression, colors, and background to that use.
maker.use.body_1: Use a simple background and a clear face for chat apps, community profiles, or a personal account. Preview the image at a small size before settling on tiny details.
maker.use.body_2: Make a character inspired by a shared hobby, a favorite jacket, or a familiar expression. Use photos or likenesses only with permission, and keep the result considerate of the people involved.
maker.use.body_3: Use your character as a visual reference for a fictional personality. Save variations to compare different outfits or moods.
maker.use.body_4: A transparent export makes it easier to place your character on a card, a personal sticker layout, or a presentation. Check the requirements of the app or printer you use.
maker.export.title: The right file for the next idea.
maker.export.description: Export the character in your preview as a ready-to-use PNG or a scalable SVG.
maker.export.png_body: The builder exports a 1024 × 1024 PNG. Select Transparent in the scene controls for a file without a background. Some profile-picture apps crop images into a circle, so leave room around the character when checking the result.
maker.export.svg_body: SVG preserves vector shapes for resizing in a layout. Check that your destination supports SVG; some apps accept only raster images. Keep the original download for later edits.
maker.export.note: Browser saves stay on this device. Downloads are yours to keep.

maker.pricing.questions_description: Know what each plan includes, how credits work, and which creation method fits your idea.
maker.pricing.question_1: How many credits does an image use?
maker.pricing.answer_1: Text generation and conversion from one photo use 15 credits for a 1K or 1.5K image, or 26 credits for 2K. Each request creates one PNG image; the generator shows the cost before you submit.
maker.pricing.question_2: What happens if my generation fails?
maker.pricing.answer_2: Credits are reserved when your request starts. If the generation fails, those credits are returned automatically. A temporary connection problem keeps your existing task available so you can check its progress without starting a second request.
maker.pricing.answer_3: One-time credit packs do not expire. Monthly credits are added after each successful payment and expire at the end of that paid billing period. They do not roll over. Canceling your subscription stops future renewals.
maker.pricing.question_4: How is the manual builder different from AI generation?
maker.pricing.answer_4: The manual builder lets you choose each character detail in a live preview and export a 1024 × 1024 PNG or an SVG. AI generation creates a new image from your description through an account-based workflow that uses credits.
